subject: design/native-routing-policy-v1
statement: `provides` satisfies `requested` iff every component is greater than or equal to the requested component in that component's closed order. In normal mode the resolver filters to qualified satisfying candidates, sorts by `(cost_rank, native_profile_id)`, and requires the first rank to be unique. Equal component tuples are `exact`; any strictly greater component is `promoted` and the result names every promoted component. No candidate yields `unsupported` with every unmet component.
